pathway_name: Employment visa and Guangzhou work permit for work over 90 days

hd_basis: No named condition in the defined contract and immigration requirement.
notes: Employer-requested or sending-country testing may be separate.

hd_basis: No HD named in Article 42 or E23 checklist; a generic communicable-disease provision is not HD.
